office_does: The treasurer collects property taxes, receives and invests county and district money, and pays out funds on authorized warrants.
race_blurb: Uncontested: Treasurer Josie Koelzer (Prefers Republican Party), in office since 2011, is the only candidate.

candidates.summary: Franklin County Treasurer since 2011 and a longtime north-county farmer; the only candidate on the ballot.
highlights: Treasurer since 2011; farm and business financial manager before that [S1]
Says office spending has stayed mostly flat as the county grew [S1]
Serves on the State Treasurer's investment pool advisory board [S1]
